descriptions.listCountries: Lists active countries. Inactive countries are excluded.
descriptions.getCountry: Returns an active country. Inactive countries are treated as not found.
descriptions.listCountryStates: Lists states for an active country in ascending ID order. Inactive countries are treated as not found.
descriptions.listSatMeasurementUnits: Returns measurement units in ascending ID order, including timestamps in the America/Monterrey time zone.
descriptions.listSatKeyOfProductsAndServices: Returns product and service keys in ascending ID order, including timestamps in the America/Monterrey time zone.
descriptions.showSiteOrganization: Resolves public organization branding by encoded slug or encoded custom domain, with plain slug or host fallback. Linked accounts are ordered by account ID.
descriptions.listPatientPortalPeople: Lists the non-deleted people authorized for the patient portal token, newest first. The response includes chat availability; a chat-service connection failure can cause the request to fail.
descriptions.showPatientPortalPersonMedicalHistory: Requires clinical sharing to be enabled for the authorized patient; otherwise returns 403 before accessing clinical data. Returns configured record groups, free-text records.allergies and saved medical_history_allergies catalogue entries. If no active history exists, this read creates a new medical history record. The editable field is true only when patient editing is enabled, including for a newly created history.
descriptions.listPatientPortalPersonOrganizationPorta: Lists eligible personal, organization-schedule and telehealth waiting-room booking links, in that order. The personal link uses the patient's selected physician account, not all historical consultation physicians. Availability depends on the organization subscription and each portal's own scheduling, patient visibility and non-empty slug settings. A default schedule is not required. Organization schedules and waiting rooms are ordered by ID; appointment history does not determine eligibility.
descriptions.listOrganizationalPortalIdentificationTy: Lists identification types for an organization. A missing, blank or unknown organization_id returns a generic Resource not found error without exposing the supplied identifier.
